title: Charge an approved rate request: confirmInTx applies a rate approved after the draft to the line it prices, on the caller's transaction, and the bill takes that rate off once
rootCause:
Confirmed by re-reading every citation at 117717c. A line's rate is set only while the order is a draft, and nothing reprices the stored lines after a later approval. The bill has a second, latent defect for exactly the lines this fix creates. Pre-dates batch 1 (probe at c5c6e03 and 7f2e198).

1. Pricing runs only at draft.
   - `priceOrderLines` (backend/libs/core/src/modules/orders/pricing-lines.ts:139-217) is the only writer of rate_paise (:192), discount_paise (:174, scheme + bargain), applied_rules (:198) and price_locked (:200).
   - Its only caller is `OrdersService.writeLines` (orders.service.ts:597-628), which deletes and re-inserts every line (:598, :612).
   - writeLines runs only on drafts: create :148, setLines :167 (draft guard :162), repeatLast :216, orders.sync.ts:143 (applyLineSync refuses a non-draft at :115), delivery/vansales.service.ts:87, ai/drafts.service.ts:157.
2. An approved rate reaches the engine only through the quote.
   - `QuoteService.loadInputs` (quote.service.ts:286-312): approved or auto_approved (:298), unexpired (:299), order_id null or this order (:300-302), newest per variant (:305-312).
   - `priceOrder()` step 4 (backend/libs/domain/src/pricing/schemes.ts:301-318) matches by variant (:304), skips a rate at or above the base rate (:307) and skips only lines locked by a final scheme (:303); a final shop rate does not block it.
   - A request still `requested` when the draft was priced is absent, so the line is written at list with price_locked false.
3. Nothing after the draft reprices.
   - `submitInTx` (orders.service.ts:254-310) reads the stored lines (:261-264) and raises the gates (:268, :292-308).
   - `ApprovalsService.decide` (approvals.service.ts:70-131) calls `bargains.decideInTx` (:102-112), which only sets status and approved_rate_paise (bargains.service.ts:185-196); the last approval calls confirmInTx (:128). `BargainsService.decide` (:144-155) does the same and nothing more.
   - `confirmInTx` (orders.service.ts:337-391) runs the DOS-020 check (:340-351), reserves the stored lines as they are (:353-381), updates the header without totals (:382-386) and emits `OrderConfirmed` with the draft total (:389).
   - docs/22 §4 line 110 ("Server re-prices at the same version, reserves stock → confirmed") is not implemented.
4. Why the naive fix fails: `QuoteService.quote()` opens its own transaction (quote.service.ts:67-71). Called inside `approvals.decide` it reads only committed rows and misses the rate approved by that same decision (probe S2, S5).
5. Second defect on the same money path: the bill takes a bargain off twice.
   - `priceOrderLineGroup` (billing/invoices.service.ts:1404-1420) bills gross = orderLine.ratePaise × qty and subtracts orderLine.discountPaise.
   - A line priced through the API stores ratePaise = the bargain rate (pricing-lines.ts:192) AND discountPaise including the bargain (:174). So its bill is (bargain rate × qty) − bargain − scheme discount.
   - For SO-0897 after the confirm fix alone, the bill would be taxable 95,784 instead of 109,296 (₹1,072.78 with GST instead of ₹1,224.12).
   - The seed prices the other way: seed-demo/sales.ts:689-700 folds the bargain into the rate and keeps it out of discount, and :865 bills value = rate × qty − discount. Billing matches the seed.
   - dos_qa, read-only: 27 lines carry a bargain in the seed's shape and 0 in the API's, so no bill there shows it yet. No billing, warehouse or delivery spec bills a bargained line (git grep).
   - Today only a rate approved before the draft (probe C1) or auto-approved reaches this. Once confirm charges approved rates, every approved rate request does.
6. Data (dos_qa, read-only).
   - SO-0897 line 01a09748-c4f6: list 5117, rate 5117, discount 0, tax 14737, line_total 137545, applied_rules [], price_locked f; header 122808 / 0 / 14737 / 137500.
   - bargain_requests 01a09748-91be: approved 4554 at 01:59:03; the order confirmed at 01:59:53.
   - The line's created_at equals the order's created_at (01:52:13.514527): the draft transaction's start.
   - Six orders from the 2026-09-13 walks carry an applicable approved rate their line lacks. SO-0897, SO-0910 and SO-0915 are confirmed; SO-0911 and SO-0914 are picking; SO-0899 is packed. SO-0910 and SO-0914 confirmed 18-65 ms after the decision, which is the same-transaction path. None is still submitted.
7. Why the design's full reprice is unsafe.
   - price_list_items rates are overwritten in place (pricing/pricing.service.ts:182-189), and schemes bump `version` in place (pricing/schemes.service.ts:186-194). Repricing on the draft's date therefore does not reproduce the draft's prices.
   - A shop-rate (override) line is price_locked too (pricing-lines.ts:200), yet a rate request on it is priced against that shop rate (bargains.service.ts:66) and the engine applies the bargain (schemes.ts:303-307).
   - Engine errors become 400s (quote.service.ts:101-103).
8. The retailer app's ask carries no orderId (frontend/retailer-app/app/order.tsx:272-281). A shop's ask is standalone and applies to any order of the shop with that item (quote.service.ts:300-302; bargains.service.ts:253), so the fix must match standalone approved rates as well as order-bound ones.

changes.what:
Build on DOS-096's merged file.

(1) Split `quote()` (:67-129).
- `quote()` keeps requireRole([...STAFF,'retailer']), requireDb and currentTenant(), and returns `withTenant(db, ctx, (tx) => this.quoteInTx(tx, ctx, input))`.
- The body moves verbatim, including DOS-096's GST lookup, into `async quoteInTx(tx: Db, ctx: TenantContext, input: QuoteIn): Promise<QuoteOut>`.
- quoteInTx opens no transaction, checks no role and never calls currentTenant() (the decideInTx shape, bargains.service.ts:164-207).

(2) Extract the approved-bargain query of `loadInputs` (:286-312) verbatim into an exported plain function `approvedBargainsFor(tx: Db, p: { tenantId: string; retailerId: string; variantIds: readonly string[]; orderId?: string | undefined }): Promise<PriceBargainInput[]>` (empty variantIds → []).
- loadInputs calls it, so one definition decides which approved rate applies to an order.
- No behaviour change; pricing.spec stays green unedited.
Export `approvedBargainsFor` next to `QuoteService, todayIst`, the same pattern as `pendingBargainsForOrder` (DOS-005): orders never reads bargain_requests itself.

Build on DOS-096's merged file (GST comes from the quote).

(1) Extract the arithmetic of `priceOrderLines` and have it use both, so drafts and confirm share one copy:
- `pricedLineFields(q)`: listRatePaise, ratePaise, discountPaise (= q.discountPaise + q.bargainPaise), discountBps, gstBps, taxPaise, lineTotalPaise, freeQtyPcs, appliedRules (via toStoredRules), priceLocked.
- `orderTotals(lines)`: subtotal = Σ(lineTotalPaise − taxPaise + discountPaise), which equals Σ gross; discount and tax sums; the same `roundToRupee`.

(2) New `repriceApprovedBargains(tx, quotes, { order: Pick<OrderRow,'id'|'retailerId'|'pricingDateMode'|'expectedDeliveryDate'>, lines: (typeof salesOrderLines.$inferSelect)[] }): Promise<{ lines; changed; totals } | null>`:
- (a) `storedBargain(l)` = ruleId of the line's `bargain` applied rule, or null.
- (b) Call `approvedBargainsFor(tx, { tenantId: currentTenant().tenantId, retailerId, orderId: order.id, variantIds })`. Return null unless some line with qtyPcs > 0 has an approved rate for its variant whose id ≠ storedBargain(l). That is one select on bargain_requests_retailer_idx, and no quote for every other order.
- (c) pricingDate = `todayIst(earliest line createdAt)`. writeLines re-inserts every line in the transaction that quoted the draft at todayIst() (quote.service.ts:73). deliveryDate = expectedDeliveryDate only when pricingDateMode = 'delivery', as writeLines passes it (orders.service.ts:603).
- (d) Call `quotes.quoteInTx(tx, currentTenant(), { retailerId, orderId, pricingDate, deliveryDate?, lines: stored.map(l => ({ lineId: l.id, variantId: l.variantId, qtyPcs: l.qtyPcs })) })`. It sends the stored qtyPcs, never enteredQty × today's case size (docs/17 A3). Engine and GST errors propagate: never catch them.
- (e) Change a line only when BOTH hold: the quoted line carries a `bargain` rule whose ruleId ≠ storedBargain(l), and q.lineNetPaise < l.lineTotalPaise − l.taxPaise.
  - Such a line takes every field of `pricedLineFields(q)`, freeQtyPcs included, so its rules and free pieces come from one engine result.
  - It keeps id, lineNo, variantId, enteredQty, enteredUnit, packSizeAtEntry, qtyPcs, pickedQtyPcs and deliveredQtyPcs.
  - Every other line is left untouched.
- (f) Return null when nothing changed; otherwise the merged lines, the changed lines and `orderTotals(merged)`.

In `confirmInTx` (:337-391), after the DOS-020 pending check (:351) and before choosing the location and reserving:
- Load the lines first: move :354-358 above :353.
- `const repriced = await repriceApprovedBargains(tx, this.quotes, { order, lines })`.
- For each `repriced.changed` line, run `tx.update(salesOrderLines).set({ listRatePaise, ratePaise, discountBps, discountPaise, gstBps, taxPaise, lineTotalPaise, freeQtyPcs, appliedRules, priceLocked, updatedAt: now }).where(eq(salesOrderLines.id, line.id))`.
  - The ids stay the same, so reservations follow.
  - The 0040 trigger sales_order_lines_touch_updated_at (clock_timestamp) moves updated_at, so the device pull brings the line with no tombstone.
- Reserve from `repriced?.lines ?? lines`.
- Spread `...(repriced?.totals ?? {})` into the header update (:382-386). `OrderConfirmed` (:389), the decide, submit and confirm replies, and the shop notification (notifications/events.ts:138, totalRupees from payload.totalPaise) then carry the charged total.
- Update the doc comment (:329-336): confirm applies a rate approved after the draft, and only that.
- Import `repriceApprovedBargains` from './pricing-lines.js'.

The shop's auto-confirm already runs inside asSystem (:286), so the line update passes staffWritePolicy (database columns.ts:227-240). quoteInTx keeps the shop's own ctx, so loadRetailer still checks the shop's link (quote.service.ts:136-151).

Nothing changes in approvals.service.ts, bargains.service.ts, the domain or the frontend.

In `priceOrderLineGroup` (:1388-1461), compute once:
`const lineDiscount = i.orderLine.ratePaise * i.orderLine.qtyPcs - (i.orderLine.lineTotalPaise - i.orderLine.taxPaise)`

Use it everywhere :1404-1409 reads `i.orderLine.discountPaise`: the zero test, the full-pack case and the `allocate` split. The stored invoice discount (:1449) follows.

Unchanged:
- The bill's rate is still orderLine.ratePaise, now the approved rate (:1419, :1447).
- appliedRules are still copied (:1458).
- GST and cess are still resolved at the invoice date.

Why this expression: the order line's stored taxable (line_total − tax, pricing-lines.ts:197) is the only invariant both stored conventions satisfy.
- API line without a bargain: it equals discountPaise, so no existing bill changes.
- API line with a bargain: it is the scheme discount alone, so the bargain comes off once.
- Seed-priced line (seed-demo/sales.ts:865, value = rate × qty − discount): it equals discountPaise.

Not touched:

architectDesignFollowed:
amended.

Kept from the design:
- The reprice happens in confirmInTx, after the DOS-020 check and before reserving.
- The quote runs on the caller's transaction (quoteInTx).
- It prices on the draft's date.
- Lines are updated in place with the same ids, and the header totals follow.
- The probe's paths become specs, including the after-create control.

Changes, each forced by the code:

(1) Which lines change. Only a line the engine now prices with an approved rate the stored line lacks, and only if that lowers its net. Every other line stays as drafted.
- Price-list rates are overwritten in place (pricing.service.ts:182-189) and schemes bump `version` in place (schemes.service.ts:186-194). A full reprice on the draft's date would silently move other lines to later edits (DOS-082's problem) and could raise a total the credit gate approved.
- It would also put engine 400s (quote.service.ts:101-103) on every confirm.

(2) price_locked is not the filter.
- A shop-rate line is locked (pricing-lines.ts:200), yet a rate request on it is priced against that shop rate (bargains.service.ts:66) and the engine applies the bargain (schemes.ts:303-307). Skipping locked lines would keep DOS-126 for those shops.
- A line already carrying the same approved rate is skipped by ruleId.

(3) A cheap pre-check, and no direct call to priceOrderLines.
- `approvedBargainsFor` (extracted from loadInputs :286-312) runs first, so an order with nothing newly approved runs no quote.
- priceOrderLines recomputes qtyPcs from enteredQty × today's case size (:146-154, docs/17 A3) and quotes in its own transaction, so the reprice shares only its extracted per-line and totals arithmetic.
- The draft's date is the IST date of the lines' created_at; sales_orders stores no pricing date.

(4) Added: the bill.
- The design assumed billing copies the corrected line. It does, but then takes the bargain off a second time (invoices.service.ts:1404-1420 against pricing-lines.ts:174 and :192).
- priceOrderLineGroup's discount becomes rate × qty − the line's stored taxable: one expression with its own spec.
- Without it, this fix turns every approved rate into an undercharged bill with under-declared GST.

(5) Added: the shop's own standalone ask auto-confirmed under asSystem (test 7), because the retailer app sends no orderId.

risk:
Money path, two modules.

1. What changes at confirm.
   - sales_order_lines are rewritten only for an order holding a rate approved after its draft, only on the line that rate prices, and only when that line's net falls.
   - A confirmed total can only go down, so a credit decision taken on the drafted total stays valid.
2. New refusal, narrow.
   - When the pre-check finds such a rate, quoteInTx runs on the draft's date. It can raise the engine's 400, for example when the draft's price list was deactivated or the item's price removed since.
   - The approval then rolls back with that message, and the order stays submitted until the price list is fixed or the gate is rejected.
   - This is deliberate (never confirm silently at the wrong rate) and far narrower than a full reprice.
3. Hot-path cost.
   - Every other confirm (submit's auto-confirm, van sale, AI drafts, the last approval) adds one indexed select on bargain_requests.
   - An order holding an approved rate the engine does not apply (the rate is at or above a shop rate, or a final scheme locks the line) also runs one quote per confirm, and writes nothing.
4. Pricing date.
   - It comes from the lines' created_at (Postgres now() at draft), compared with the quote's JS todayIst(). A draft written within milliseconds of IST midnight could price the bargained line on the neighbouring date.
   - If the office edited that item's list rate or scheme between draft and confirm, the bargained line uses the edited rows for its date. The charged rate is exactly the approved rate, but its scheme discount and free pieces follow the edit. Other lines are untouched.
5. Standalone approved rates (a shop's ask carries no orderId) also reprice a held order of that shop at confirm, as the engine would at draft.
6. Devices: lines keep their ids and the 0040 trigger moves updated_at (clock_timestamp), so the rep's and the shop's delta pull bring the new rate; no tombstone.
7. Billing.
   - priceOrderLineGroup's discount becomes rate × qty − stored taxable.
   - Identical for every line without an API-stored bargain: all existing billing, warehouse and delivery specs, and all 27 seed-priced bargain lines in dos_qa.
   - Fixes the double deduction for API-stored bargains. On those lines, invoice discount registers then report scheme discounts only.
8. Merge conflicts.
